scope: Actual comparison of all3 source144 repair returns and both successful open-neck-later returns, including full raw views of Bartolome, Eva, Jesus and Juan, plus the earlier rejected complete raw of Eva/Jesus/Juan. Source144 repair1 now has a compact head seated directly in the shirt collar; repair3 restores the actual strong left profile and far-eye occlusion: these2 pass. Eva has restored the thin pale inner smile strip but still lacks the compact neck/body fit. Jesus and Juan still need a decisive shoulder/collar adaptation, so neither is counted qualified merely for returning again. The third open-neck-later request failed service rather than returning an image, and remains separate; no replacement art call is prepared for that held source.

decisions.display_source: Unchanged raw master with display-only white/cyan matte and nearest alpha; never game payload.
decisions.reason: The actual complete returned raw and earlier rejected raw were compared. The lower face still extends into a separate long tapered yellow neck down to the source open V; the requested compact-head/body layout has not been achieved. Make a decisive ANATOMICAL AND GARMENT-FIT change: use a near-round mascot head with a clearly curved lower chin; raise the existing garment shoulder tops and widen its collar circumference so the open collar begins immediately beneath that chin. Seat the round head low between those adapted shoulders, with an almost hidden VERY SHORT BROAD neck. Preserve the original OPEN neckline and actual folded layers; the visible yellow area lower inside the V can only be a broad upper chest, not a vertical human-neck stalk continuing the cheek sides. Do not leave the target head high over unchanged narrow shoulders. Do not conceal anatomy with a new high collar, scarf, closed throat, shirt insert, tie or cream bib. Keep the actual hair, source expression, face direction, illumination, crop, photo frame/note and wholly opaque photo content. This exact source has swept/gathered wavy light-brown/blond hair, brown outer garment and pale OPEN folded neck layers. Keep the actual very thin pale INNER smile/tooth strip that is now present; no wide grin, tongue or large teeth.
